title: Butterfly holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M52 55 Q56 66 50 75' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='38' rx='11' ry='14' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='38' rx='11' ry='14' fill='none' stroke='#ff8fa3' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='33' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#ffb3c1' opacity='0.8'/>
  <polygon points='49,52 55,52 52,57' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <polygon points='49,52 55,52 52,56' fill='none' stroke='#ff8fa3' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- butterfly body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='3' ry='10' fill='#845ec2'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='3' ry='10' fill='none' stroke='#b39ddb' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- butterfly head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='4.5' fill='#845ec2'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='4.5' fill='none' stroke='#b39ddb' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='59' r='1.2' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='59' r='1.2' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d='M48 57 Q44 50 40 48' stroke='#b39ddb' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 57 Q56 50 60 48' stroke='#b39ddb' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='48' r='1.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='48' r='1.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- left wings -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='63' rx='12' ry='9' transform='rotate(-20 35 63)' fill='#4cc9f0'/>
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='63' rx='12' ry='9' transform='rotate(-20 35 63)' fill='none' stroke='#90e0ef' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='75' rx='9' ry='6' transform='rotate(-10 36 75)' fill='#4cc9f0'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='75' rx='9' ry='6' transform='rotate(-10 36 75)' fill='none' stroke='#90e0ef' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='61' r='2.5' fill='#fff3b0'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='74' r='1.8' fill='#fff3b0'/>
  <!-- right wings -->
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='63' rx='12' ry='9' transform='rotate(20 65 63)' fill='#f9c74f'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='63' rx='12' ry='9' transform='rotate(20 65 63)' fill='none' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='75' rx='9' ry='6' transform='rotate(10 64 75)' fill='#f9c74f'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='75' rx='9' ry='6' transform='rotate(10 64 75)' fill='none' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='61' r='2.5' fill='#fff3b0'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='74' r='1.8' fill='#fff3b0'/>
  <!-- arm holding string -->
  <path d='M52 66 Q56 70 54 73' stroke='#b39ddb' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
